assessments.reasoning: The official release tag resolves to commit 04696df09633baf97cdbbdd6e9929b9d472161d3, the commit pinned by all five release-text acquisitions. I independently recomputed the revision 1 claim digest from the 1,564 delivered record bytes, including the final LF, and obtained the reported value. The exact 3,324-byte COPYING.RUNTIME hashed to 9d6b43ce4d8de0c878bf16b54d8e7a10d9bd42b75178153e3af6a815bdc90f74. Its opening [248,580) hashed to 25b5911740d53cd648267246d1bdafe9d9c053a4ff7dde791e37108d6def395b and its §1 range [2692,3122) to bba1d5a0d5025d33c2f24bced117698312ff76e29bb5f718f02779d55b6eb90c. Both notice-excerpt digests also matched on recomputation. [Official release tag](https://gnu.googlesource.com/gcc/+/refs/tags/releases/gcc-14.2.0)

challenge.method: Substituted the same-release GPLv2 §7 for GPLv3 §7, applied the opening's notice criterion to iostream and the GPL-only libcc1.cc notice, tested a later-version election under GPLv3 §14, and tested whether the opening alone could establish §1 permission for a Target Code combination.
challenge.results: GPLv3 §7 defines additional permissions. GPLv2 §7 addresses conflicting obligations and can require withholding distribution, so the earlier-edition substitution fails. The iostream notice expressly grants Exception 3.1 permissions under GPLv3 §7. The libcc1.cc notice offers GPLv3 or later and lacks the exception grant, so it fails the opening's notice criterion. A program's §14 election concerns the version applicable to that program and leaves the exception's express GPLv3 §7 reference intact. Section 1 requires a Target Code combination with Independent Modules and Eligible Compilation Processes for all Target Code. Conveyance must also respect the Independent Modules' licenses. A qualifying file notice alone supplies no evidence of those facts. The controls disclose no material contradiction for the scoped relationship.

limitations: The GPLv2 and GPLv3 controls and the two file notices were delivered as excerpts. Their full-file SHA-256 values were not independently recomputed, and the GPL section excerpts were inspected without separately recomputing their range digests.

The claim identifies the base edition and the file-notice condition. It does not resolve a particular program's version election or establish permission to propagate or convey any particular Target Code combination.
reasoning: The GCC 14.2.0 COPYING.RUNTIME identifies Runtime Library Exception 3.1 as an additional permission under GPLv3 §7 and makes application to a given file depend on a copyright-holder notice specifying GPLv3 with the exception.
